text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"‘The spring of one's life’... I've heard 
that phrase in poems before, but..."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Who knew there could be a spring 
where every single dream comes true like 
this!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Osaka Hai, the Tenno Sho (Spring), and 
the Takarazuka Kinen. Running in every 
single one, and claiming victory—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black brilliantly achieved the 
Spring Senior Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It's almost too good to be true! But, we 
did it, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes, thank you so much! The ones I most 
want to celebrate with are Trainer, 
Dia-chan, and...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: And then... one more person.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Who, who? Who is it~?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Isn't it obvious, Teio-san? That's Tei...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what theee, Teio-san!? Why are you 
here?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Of course I came to celebrate! I wanted to 
be the first to congratulate you too, you 
know.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You did it, Kita-chan. You achieved the 
Spring Senior Triple Crown! Accomplishing 
something so incredible... I'm so happy 
for you!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes, thank you so much! This is all thanks 
to Teio-san!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: And so—here you go! A present from me.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Wh-What is this?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
To commemorate winning the Spring Senior 
Triple Crown, here's a Teio-blend "Special 
Hachimii"♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I got it in your favorite flavor and sized 
up to extra-large, so give it a try!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, yes, thank you so much! In that 
case, I'll go with this Special Hachimii!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Cheeeers! *gulp*, *gulp*, so goooood!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black chugged her victory Hachimii 
down in one gulp, and then...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... Teio-san. Since we're here, just 
one more! May I offer just one more 
celebration?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh, yeah, sure, but... what is it?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse me! It's a bit hard to say 
this, but well~~~.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Is she here yet~? Is she here yet~? 
Teio-san, are you here yet~?"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Sorry to keep you waiting, Kita-chaan.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Just like you said, I put on the racing 
silks from when I won the Classic Double 
Crown. Is this okay?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Thank you so much! It's just 
like... what I dreamed of that day!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan is... in casual clothes, huh. 
What are you going to do in those?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Teio-san, in that outfit... please dance a 
celebratory dance with me!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Boom-chiki-cha, boom-chiki♪ Yaaaay!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you're so silly, Kita-chan! Why did 
you want to do something like this?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Because~ I get to dance together with 
Teio-san, looking just like the figure 
I've always admired, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Wearing casual clothes makes me feel like 
I've gone back to those days too!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"I feel like my heart's about to leap for 
joy. Running with the one and only 
Teio-san...!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"I've improved enough to be worthy of 
dancing with you, now...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Reverting to a child at heart, Kitasan 
Black kept dancing happily on and on.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much, Teio-san! Doing the 
Teio Step together with you was so much 
fun!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm gonna head out now. Don't 
forget, Kita-chan.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Now that you've conquered the Spring 
Senior Triple Crown, you're not just 
looking up to others—you're someone to be 
looked up to!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Be someone the other girls can look up to, 
okay? Take good care of Kita-chan's 
Trainer too, please!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Teio-san...! Yes, I'll do my very best!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Receiving blessings even from Tokai Teio, 
whom she looked up to... it became the 
ultimate spring banquet.
